column1: # TLA+: the module (package); operator and function definitions at module level, LOCAL ones too (function; infix, prefix and postfix operators are named by their symbol); INSTANCE bindings (package); CONSTANT (constant, operator constants too) and VARIABLE (variable) declarations; named ASSUME, THEOREM and LEMMA (constant: a named proposition).
# Not listed: operators defined in a LET, bound variables, unnamed ASSUME and THEOREM, RECURSIVE declarations.
